scope: CUDA events around a repeated graph of the observation kernel only. Reused fixed archived state and hot weights; diagnostic, not a full-march or end-to-end speed claim. No reuse of these warmed runtimes by an accuracy or timing arm.
comparison: One original 128-thread block with six serial dot products versus one 192-thread block with six full FP64 warps. Each lane accumulates source indices lane+32j, then uses a fixed shuffle tree. Checkpoint, state, and index semantics are unchanged.
promotion_rule: Microseconds are scope-limited. Candidate must preserve bitwise states, checkpoints and index, both strict probe gates, and full physical and wake qualification before any end-to-end claim. If speed benefit is confined to hot fixed-state kernels, keep it as a diagnostic.
